data.explanation: This online shop says it hasn't received your payment of €64.98 for an order from 2 April 2026 and asks you to transfer it by 15 May 2026. If you already paid, the letter says you can disregard it. Check your bank records first; if the amount is indeed unpaid, transfer it to the IBAN shown using the invoice number as reference to avoid further reminders or fees. No consequence for missing this specific date is stated in the letter, but further dunning letters or fees are typical if it remains unpaid.
